Could you adapt to living where the sea and the community set the rhythm of each day?

replies.author: @motu4883
replies.text: Oh and the chiefs are passed down through matrilineal too. You can only become chief through the mom side. If the chief have a daughter, and the daughter have a boy, then they will be the next chief in line

replies.author: @motu4883
replies.text: I’m from Micronesia, yap to be exact. Land is passed down from the mother side. I have 7 uncles and 1 aunt, and the other one is my mom. My mom and my aunt, have the right to the land my grandma and grandpa grew up on. But we also have other acres of land across different islands. Usually our grandparents would give a piece of land to their kids to grow up on. But the main land that our grandparents grew up in is ours. Their grandchildren and their daughters. So when I go home, I have more right than anyone at home. I can tell who and where they can move to. But it goes by age. Like an onion. The outer layer is the the people ahead of us, when they pass away it is passed down to the younger brother and so on. So for example, my aunt, and my mom both have daughters. If they get kids, their kids will one day be the land owners. It’s not something we want to take part of but it’s obligation .. sorry if I don’t make any sense haha
